evals.name: no-account-enumeration
evals.prompt: On a failed login our error message reads: 'No account exists with that email address.' Any problem with that copy?
evals.expected_output: Yes — this enables account enumeration (reveals whether an email is registered). Use a single neutral message like 'Your email or password is incorrect.' Same neutrality applies to password-reset ('if an account exists, we sent instructions').
evals.truth: yes — account enumeration; use neutral combined error

evals.name: biometric-stores-credential
evals.prompt: We want Face ID login for returning users. Does Face ID replace our server authentication, and where should the credential live?
evals.expected_output: Face ID does NOT replace server auth — it UNLOCKS a stored credential. Store the session/refresh token in the Keychain (Android: Keystore) and gate it with the biometric API; always provide a passcode/password fallback. Offer to enable it AFTER the first successful password sign-in.
evals.truth: no — biometrics unlock a Keychain-stored token, with fallback
